authoritative_questions: Does implementation meet defined quality rules?
dimensions: false positives, suppressions, trends, and remediation evidence
evidence_priorities: linter configuration, rule sets, outputs, and suppressions
source population, test, defect, and change history
quality thresholds, false-positive evidence, and remediation records
focus.mission: Apply the Linter and Code Quality Reviewer focus to determine: Does implementation meet defined quality rules, using only exact eligible evidence and preserving uncertainty and human authority.
prohibited_conclusions: Do not declare the whole product safe, secure, compliant, reliable, ready, approved, or acceptable.
Do not convert missing, inaccessible, or unreviewed evidence into no findings or effective controls.
required_methods: Inspect only the declared eligible evidence population using the role's pinned domain criteria.
Separate observations, assessments, findings, unknowns, and recommendations while preserving exact evidence locators.
Apply the role-specific dimensions: rule applicability and execution coverage, code-quality, correctness, and maintainability signals, false positives, suppressions, trends, and remediation evidence.
required_outputs: coverage, confidence, limitations, and evidence locators
CAPA options and human decision requests
role-specific coverage of rule applicability and execution coverage, code-quality, correctness, and maintainability signals, false positives, suppressions, trends, and remediation evidence
rubric_checks: Every actionable claim is supported by an exact eligible evidence reference.
The output applies the named domain dimensions rather than generic review language.
Missing evidence, uncertainty, and authority boundaries remain explicit.
The result materially addresses rule applicability and execution coverage, code-quality, correctness, and maintainability signals, false positives, suppressions, trends, and remediation evidence.

handoff.consumer_rule: A consumer may summarize this role's output only when the focus identity, source meaning, evidence, disagreement, limitations, and authority boundary remain traceable.
